description: This file defines the LoadSheddingOptions class, encapsulating configuration options related to load shedding in Orleans. It includes properties for enabling load shedding, CPU threshold, and memory threshold, with some defaults and deprecated members.

classes.name: LoadSheddingOptions
classes.description: A class providing options for configuring load shedding behavior, including thresholds for CPU and memory utilization, and enabling/disabling load shedding.

methods.name: LoadSheddingOptions
methods.description: Default constructor for LoadSheddingOptions, implicitly used; initializes CPU and memory thresholds to default values.
